name: Moby
summary: An industrial humanoid designed on an explicitly anti-anthropomorphic premise: match the human workflow, not the human body. Moby is built for terrain other humanoids avoid — stairs, ramps, scaffolding, soft ground, outdoors — with modular end-effectors and a whole-body AI stack that takes new tasks from spoken instruction and demonstration.
notable: Built for scaffolding, ramps and outdoor terrain rather than flat floors
